data.title: Preview: Lille vs Bayern Munich - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
## Team News

Lille are still having to cope without Tiago Santos and Hamza Igamane who are recovering from long-term knee injuries, but Ethan Mbappe is available to return from a three-match UCL suspension and is set to rival Dilane Bakwa for a start on the right flank. [...] Manuel Neuer (foot), Alphonso Davies (knee/muscle), Serge Gnabry (hamstring) and Ismael Saibari (ankle) are also in the treatment room, while Luis Diaz (hamstring) and Michael Olise (foot) are both doubtful, the latter of whom was seen on crutches and wearing a protective boot after the win over Koln.

In the absence of Kane, the likes of Diaz - if fit - Jamal Musiala, Noah Codjo-Evora, 17, and Bastian Assomo, 16, are potential candidates to lead the line for Bayern. [...] Tanguy Nianzou, who made four UCL appearances for Bayern in the 2021-22 campaign, is likely to start at the heart of the defence alongside Alexsandro, while Nabil Bentaleb, Ngal'ayel Mukau and Benjamin Andre are all set to play in midfield.

As for Bayern, they suffered a major injury blow last Friday as 2026 Ballon d’Or winner Harry Kane suffered a torn syndesmosis ligament which required surgery. The striker is now expected to be sidelined for at least a few months.

## Team news

As well as Kane and Olise, Bayern have travelled to Lille without Manuel Neuer (tendon tear in foot), Serge Gnabry (muscle injury), Ismael Saibari (syndesmosis tear) and Alphonso Davies (hamstring strain). Luis Díaz is available again after a minor muscle tear in his hamstring.

Tiago Santos, Hamza Igamane (both cruciate ligament injuries) and former FCB player Tanguy Nianzou (muscle injury) are absent for the hosts.
